decision.reason: The changelog line [ev-da6dc6a7dbe9] and PR #9545 [ev-004f35ff5f4a] only say the PR will "Set up the right log level on the logger", changing cmd/traefik/logger.go [ev-f2659d4f0f0a]. They do not describe the bug in #9544. They also don't say which configured levels or versions were affected, or whether any released version an operator could upgrade from had the wrong behaviour. Without that, I can't tell whether doing nothing changes anything an operator can see (behavior-change) or nothing at all (none). The issue #9544 description, or text saying which versions logged at the wrong level, is needed to decide.
